chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Hammad al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ubayd Allah ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Ibn Yaqtin who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever is afflicted by an earthquake, let him recite: O He who
"He holds the heavens and the earth from ceasing (to exist), and if they were to cease, no one could hold them after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing, Forgiving."
Pray upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and hold back evil from us. 'Indeed, You are over all things competent.'
He (the Imam) said: 'Indeed, whoever recites it before sleeping, a house will not fall upon him, if God wills.'

key_terms.يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ: He holds the heavens and the earth (Quranic phrase)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite during an earthquake according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration highlights the practical application of Quranic recitation for physical protection during natural disasters, specifically earthquakes. It links the divine attribute of sustaining the cosmos with a tangible benefit—protection from structural collapse—emphasizing the intercession of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as part of the supplicatory formula.
